summary: Feed s176_triple is degraded with 3 high-severity faults: required VLAN 20 missing (48% untagged), 6.0% TCP packet drops, and NDR port overload at 12.81 Gbps (128% of 10 Gbps capacity). NDR has incomplete payload and segmentation visibility.

findings.root_cause: Required VLAN 20 not seen and 48% of packets are untagged, indicating VLAN tags are being stripped upstream - likely packet broker configured to strip 802.1Q or SPAN/TAP not forwarding tagged traffic for VLAN 20.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR loses segmentation context for VLAN 20; cannot correlate detections to correct tenant/segment and will miss lateral movement or policy violations isolated to that VLAN. Violates tool profile requiring VLANs [10,20].

recommended_fix.why: Preserve and forward 802.1Q tags for VLANs 10 and 20 through TAP/SPAN and packet broker to NDR so it can enforce segmentation-aware detection.

findings.root_cause: 6.0% of TCP packets (505/8429) show gaps/retransmission holes consistent with buffer drops upstream - classic SPAN oversubscription or packet broker egress queue drops under burst, not normal network loss.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR cannot reassemble full TCP streams due to missing payload; needs_full_payload=true is violated, causing missed signatures, broken flow reassembly, and false negatives for IDS/NDR detections.

recommended_fix.why: Passive TAP delivers lossless, line-rate copy without SPAN buffer limitations; eliminates the 6% capture loss and ensures complete payload delivery to NDR.

findings.root_cause: Peak burst of 12.81 Gbps in 1ms interval exceeds the NDR's 10 Gbps port capacity by 28% (128% utilization) across 2 intervals - feed is bursting beyond single-tool capacity.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR ingress drops packets during bursts due to port oversubscription; even if upstream is lossless, tool itself discards traffic, creating blind spots exactly during high-volume (often attack-relevant) periods.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute traffic via packet broker load-balancing across 2x10G NDR ports or add aggregation/load-balancer to absorb 12.81 Gbps bursts without drops.
